scope.task: Typed authority/status routing, exact request binding and evidence copying under a fixed JSON protocol.

train.use: Only permitted future gradient input after separate signed admission.

dev.use: Development only; never a final promotion result or gradient input.

heldout.use: Final public frozen protocol gate; never a gradient or tuning input.

review_limits.common_protocol_content: System prompt, JSON keys/enums and fixed claim strings are intentionally shared.
review_limits.textual_non_overlap: Independent software checks compare family, IDs, requests and task/value strings after removing digests, timestamps, numeric tokens and split markers. This is not a semantic-independence proof.
review_limits.filesystem_scope: Generators are reproducibility utilities for an owner-controlled single-writer checkout, not authorization boundaries. Admission separately snapshots and checks train-only inputs.

before_any_training: Merge and freshly verify the exact source under repository policy.
Bind an owner-signed curriculum and independently pinned signer trust to these immutable commitments.
Implement and review a source-current v4 train-only loader/trainer and supervised containment/resource guards; do not reuse a v3-bound launcher.
Qualify the exact base revision, tokenizer, dependencies, sequence lengths and available hardware without truncating contract targets.
Run a bounded supervised smoke and emit actual chained evidence: dataset/base/harness hashes, seed, hardware, loss and measured metrics. Keep REPORTED until outside replay.
before_any_publication: Run the frozen model-output gate without training or tuning on its cases.
Obtain independent replay and protected release authorization.
Use the new candidate Hub identity, retain predecessor signed SKUs and enforce one writer.
